description:
This is a very short trail which leads down to a dinosaur trackway. From the Parking area, walk under the railroad tracks and follow the trail down to the river.

The trail is rated easy.

Please be respectful of the site and take only photos.

This trail is maintained by the Wolverine Nordic & Mountain Society.

Wolverine Nordic & Mountain Society

Photos and Maps courtesy of the WNMS.
directions: From Tumbler Ridge, drive North on 29 towards Chetwynd for 5.4km. The trailhead is on the West side of the Hwy.
